'''2004 Rhode Island State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship played on 17 July 2004 at Scholar's Books And Games, 34 Central Square, Bridgewater, Massachusetts. The venue was in southern Massachusetts, close to Rhode Island, and was chosen because it was easy to reach and familiar. [[Paul Maholick]] was tournament director, and [[Michael Pistone]] announced the event.<ref name="pcf-3533-48313">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=48313#48313 RI States July 17th!!!], Michael Pistone, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (29 June 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041210023513/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=48313%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> According to Pistone's forum signature (captured December 2004), he was the 2004 Rhode Island State Champion.<ref name="pcf-3533-48313" />

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Scholar's Books And Games, 34 Central Square, Bridgewater, Massachusetts<ref name="pcf-3533-48313" />
* '''Dates:''' 17 July 2004, 12:00<ref name="pcf-3533-48313" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Paul Maholick]]<ref name="pcf-3533-48313" />
* '''Structure:''' six games and a final confrontation; decklists required<ref name="pcf-3533-48313" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $5 or less<ref name="pcf-3533-48313" />

Prizes were tournament foils, with packs possible if players were interested, and the winner received a bye into Day 2 of the [[2004 World Championship|World Championship]].<ref name="pcf-3533-48313" />
